annotations.title: Find billing codes and Medicare rates by plain words

description: Med Bill Check. Find billing codes and Medicare rates by plain words. For when someone describes a service but has no code, or asks what a code means, for example "what's the code for a colonoscopy?", "how much does Medicare pay for a chest x-ray in Ohio?" or "what is code 99214?". Returns up to eight matching codes with Medicare's typical allowed and billed amounts.

q.description: Plain words or a code, like "hernia repair" or 99214.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code.
